What's your return and refund policy?
One Fast Cat • AI Assistant
Here’s the return and refund policy I found:



Returns: One Fast Cat products purchased through onefastcat.com can be returned for a full refund within 90 days of purchase, provided they are still in good condition.


Cat Exercise Wheels (USA contiguous 48 states): customers are asked to keep the item for at least 30 days as a 30 Day Training Trial before returning.


International, Alaska, Hawaii, and U.S. territories: returns are also accepted within 90 days, provided items are in good condition.


Condition requirements: for Cat Exercise Wheels and Giant Scratching Towers, items must be wiped clean of dust and fur, disassembled, and shipped back in the original box to qualify.


Non-returnable condition: items contaminated with feces, urine, or blood cannot be returned.


Shipping costs: shipping fees are not refundable, and return shipping fees will not be reimbursed.


Customer responsibility: it is the customer’s responsibility to return the item to One Fast Cat for a refund. If the item is not shipped back, a refund cannot be issued.


Lost return packages: if a returned package is lost in transit, it may still be eligible for a refund if you can provide proof the label was scanned and accepted by the carrier.


Refused deliveries: packages refused by the recipient and returned to sender are treated as a standard return, and the refund is less all freight fees (original shipping fees, duties, and return shipping fees).


Marketplace purchases: items bought through Amazon, eBay, or Chewy must be returned through those platforms under their policies.



The latest policy page listed is: https://onefastcat.com/pages/returns
